title: The colour picker loses its red
hints: Pairs made only of digits work. Try a single letter digit: what should `'A'` be worth, and what does the helper return for it?
In the letter branch, `u - 'A'` gives 0 for `'A'`, 1 for `'B'` and so on. But hex `A` means ten, so every letter digit comes out 10 too small.
